concept.title: Microsoft Azure services for Red Hat Quay
concept.shortdesc: When you run Red Hat Quay on Microsoft Azure, you can use Azure managed PostgreSQL, Blob Storage (hot), and Azure Cache for Redis for backend services. You can reference the overview when planning your Azure deployment.
